notes.title: Patch 0.005
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Apple attack increased from 15 to 25
[*] A one-time sword has been added to the game, only the "Hiding" can raise it. Sword can kill "Seekers".
[*] Added chat in the lobby.
[*] Launched a new event, time online. During the time you are in the lobby you get experience and coins.
[*] Figurines are now highlighted for "Seekers"
[*] The longer the apple flies, the more damage will be.
[*] Be careful, "Seekers" can kill their own.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.004
notes.content:
Hi everyone, thanks for playing "Hide and Seek" in order to make it even more interesting for you, I bring variety to the game.

[list]
[*] New lobby.
[*] Account level
Now when you kill or raise figurines, you get experience.
[*] Game currency.
Now when you kill or pick up figurines, there is a chance to get coins.
[*] Now you can customize your character before the game.
[/list]

Thank you all for participating in the development of the game, I try for you.

At the end of the month I will give away prizes in the form of keys to the game.

I wish you a pleasant game.[/b]

notes.title: Patch 0.002
notes.content:
I apologize for the fact that the game has not been updated for a long time.
I had good reasons for that.

[list]
[*] Many of you wrote to me that you are bored of playing alone. For this, I run a dedicated server. Please note that it is in beta testing. 
To play on a dedicated server, select the first menu item.

[*] In order to add excitement to the game, I introduced a rating system.
At the moment, the collection of statistics about players has been launched.

[*] Two new skills have been added to the game.
Skill "Wave" is in the team "Seekers", after using the skill, all nearby players glow for 5 seconds and can not be transformed into objects.

The team "Hiding" has the skill "Fog", after using the skill, all players standing nearby are blinded for 5 seconds.

[*] New rules of the game.
The game has two teams, each team has its own tasks.
 
The team "Seekers" have apples with which they must kill the team "Hiding".
In order to win, their timer must reach zero before the Iskatele team collects the necessary points.

The "Hiding" team should collect statues on the map. It takes away points from the main account and adds not much time to the timer. When one of the players from the team dies, points are added. In order to win you need to spend all the points.

[*] Game maps have been updated and several maps are under reconstruction.

[*] Were also updated game bots that are in a single game.

[*] Many other new updates that you can notice during the game.
[/list] 

[b]Dear players, a big request to you.
If you find any bugs or you have any suggestions, feel free to write to the community, I will be very grateful to you.
Let's make the game better together.[/b]

notes.title: Tournament (free)
notes.content:
Hello!
At the moment, we have scored a sufficient number of players to hold the tournament.

Many of you have written that it is hard to find a network game and it’s boring to play with bots alone, I understand you.

In order to diversify the game, I decided to hold for you two tournaments, 1x1 and 5x5 with a cash prize fund which I will report later.

I will also add a network game against bots so that teams can train.

In order to hold a tournament I need to expand the possibilities of the game, it will take time. I want to ask you, is it interesting to you?

Write your wishes in the comments below, thanks for playing [b]"Hide and Seek"[/b]

notes.title: Game rules
notes.content:
Welcome to the game "Hide and Seek".
In order to play you must know the rules of the game.
The game has two teams, each team has its own tasks.
The team "Hiden" must include a timer to win.
The Seeker command should capture the control points, but it cannot do this while the timer is on.

On the map there are buttons for turning on the timer, control points, lives and additional apples.

All items that can be transformed are highlighted.

Write your feedback and suggestions on the forum, we will try to improve the game for you.
Enjoy your game!
